'''2001 UK Open''' was a Star Wars CCG Open championship in the United Kingdom in late August 2001. [[Jamie Giberti]] played a Dark list there and posted it the next day.<ref name="dt-18728">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18728 Uk Open DS - Maul Strikes], DeckTech (Jamie "JEEBS" Giberti, 1 September 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18728/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18728/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 31 August 2001
* '''Site:''' United Kingdom
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]

The date is the day before Giberti's 1 September 2001 post, which calls the event "yesterday".<ref name="dt-18728" />
